p='products/services/opire-reward-directory/raw/application.html'

urls=sorted(set(re.findall(r'https?://[a-zA-Z0-9./_\-#?=&%]+',t)))
print('urls',[u for u in urls if 'static' not in u][:80])
txt=re.sub(r'<script.*?</script>','',t,flags=re.S);txt=re.sub(r'<style.*?</style>','',txt,flags=re.S);txt=re.sub(r'<[^>]+>',' ',txt);txt=re.sub(r'\s+',' ',txt)
